notes.title: Yo How u doing. Here is a little update for you
notes.content:
Hi, 

Yes, I am still updating this game:
-you can now change your movement type in settings to head/right/left hand based
-Bigger 21:9 Settings screen, much better feel
-A small Easter Egg
-...more to come

Best,
Templenny

notes.title: How to spawn a new Gun?
notes.content:
A little improvement on how the gun will spawn across the map
-Press the orange button to spawn the gun
-The gun will now automatically respawn if it touches the lava
